nodes.label: Favicon Light (NewEra Logo - Light Theme)
nodes.description: Light-theme favicon for NewEra365 web app. Displays the 'NEWERA' wordmark in bold black text on a white background. The letter 'N' incorporates a green candlestick chart graphic element — a small green bullish candlestick replacing or overlaying the vertical stroke — reinforcing the forex/CFD trading brand identity. Used as the browser tab icon for the light color scheme.

nodes.label: NewEra365 Brand Logo
nodes.description: The NewEra365 brand logo concept: 'NEWERA' wordmark with a green candlestick icon embedded in the letter N, symbolizing forex/CFD trading. Appears in both light and dark favicon variants.
